name: How to Hatch the Dragon Egg in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Short answer: you cannot - the dragon egg does not hatch in vanilla Minecraft. It is a trophy block: one per world from the first ender dragon kill (two in Bedrock). To actually pick it up, make it fall onto a torch or push it with a piston, because mining it makes it teleport away.
steps: Beat the ender dragon: the egg appears on top of the exit portal's bedrock fountain after your first kill. Only one exists per world (a Bedrock quirk grants a second for the second dragon).
Do not mine it directly: attacking the egg makes it teleport to a random air block up to 15 blocks horizontally and 7 vertically.
Torch trick: mine the block under the egg and place a torch in its place - the egg falls, lands on the torch and drops as an item. A bottom slab works too.
Piston trick: place a piston facing the egg and activate it - the push makes the egg drop as an item instantly.
If it teleports away, hunt the purple particle trail - it never goes far, and it always checks for ground beneath its landing spot.
Display it: the egg emits light level 1 and sits nicely on an item frame-free pedestal. That is its whole job - no hatching, no baby dragon, no second use in vanilla.
materials: A piston and a lever/button, or torches
A pickaxe for the block under the egg
Anything you needed to kill the ender dragon
editionNote: Bedrock worlds can get two dragon eggs (one from each of the first two dragon kills) - Java worlds only ever get one.
versions: Dragon egg since Java 1.0.0; Bedrock 1.0.

faq.q: Can you hatch the dragon egg in Minecraft?
faq.a: Not in vanilla. No mechanic, no crafting recipe and no incubation exists - Mojang has only ever treated it as a trophy. Mods and datapacks that hatch it are not part of the base game.

faq.q: How do you pick up the dragon egg?
faq.a: Make it fall onto a non-full block like a torch or bottom slab, or push it with a piston - both make it drop as an item. Mining it directly just makes it teleport.

faq.q: What happens if you lose the dragon egg?
faq.a: It is gone for good in Java - one per world, and respawning the dragon does not make another. In Bedrock the second dragon drops a second egg, but that is the ceiling.

keywords: dragon egg hatch minecraft how to pick up teleport torch piston trophy ender dragon

name: How to Dye Armor in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Only leather armor (plus leather horse armor and wolf armor) can be dyed. In Java, craft the armor piece with any dyes in a crafting grid - repeat to mix colors. In Bedrock, dye water in a cauldron and dip the armor in it, one water layer per piece. Dip dyed armor in clean cauldron water to undye it.
steps: Craft the leather armor pieces you want - dyeing works on leather armor, leather horse armor and wolf armor only, never iron, diamond or netherite.
Gather dyes: 16 colors, mostly from flowers; green and lime come from smelting cactus and sea pickles, and every dye is sold by the wandering trader.
Java: put the armor piece in a crafting grid with any combination of dyes. You can dye the same piece repeatedly and previous colors blend into the result.
Bedrock: fill a cauldron with water, use a dye on it to color the water, then use the armor on the cauldron. Each piece consumes one water layer; adding more dye mixes the water color.
Mix freely: millions of colors are possible (5.7 million in Java), so stack dyes until you hit the exact shade.
To undo: use the dyed armor on a cauldron of clean water - it returns to the default leather color, keeping enchantments and its anvil name.
materials: Leather armor pieces (or leather horse armor / wolf armor)
Dyes - flowers, smelting, or the wandering trader
Bedrock only: a cauldron and water buckets
editionNote: The whole mechanic differs by edition: Java dyes in the crafting grid with color mixing on repeat crafts; Bedrock requires a cauldron of dyed water and consumes one layer per piece.
versions: Armor dyeing since Java 1.4.2; wolf armor dyeing since 1.20.5.

faq.q: Can you dye netherite or iron armor?
faq.a: No. Only leather armor, leather horse armor and wolf armor accept dye. Other armor sets keep their fixed look - use trims for those.

faq.q: How do you dye armor in Bedrock?
faq.a: Fill a cauldron with water, add dye to color the water, then use the armor piece on the cauldron. One water layer dyes one piece; clean water undyes.

faq.q: How many armor colors are possible?
faq.a: Millions - colors mix on every re-dye. Java has 5,713,438 obtainable colors in Survival, far beyond the 16 base dyes.

name: How to Make a Lead in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a lead with 5 string: string in the top-left 2x2 corner and one in the bottom-right slot - the recipe gives 2 leads. Since 1.21.6 no slimeball is needed (the old recipe was 4 string + 1 slimeball). Leads leash most passive mobs and tie them to fences.

faq.q: How do you make a lead in Minecraft?

faq.q: Do you need a slimeball for a lead?

name: How to Make Smooth Stone in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Smelt regular stone in a furnace: cobblestone smelts into stone, and stone smelts again into smooth stone. It takes two smelting passes per block - use a blast furnace to double the speed. Smooth stone makes smooth stone slabs (stonecutter), blast furnaces and armor stands.
steps: Mine cobblestone with any pickaxe - smooth stone drops nothing without a pickaxe, so keep one handy.
First smelt: put cobblestone in a furnace with fuel to get regular stone.
Second smelt: smelt that stone again to get smooth stone. Two passes, two fuel units per block.
Speed it up with a blast furnace: it smelts stone-type blocks twice as fast (and is itself crafted from smooth stone - chicken and egg for the first one, so use a normal furnace first).
Skip the grind in villages: smooth stone generates naturally in plains, savanna and snowy tundra villages, and mason houses have chests with it.
Use it: smooth stone slabs (3 smooth stone in a row, or 1 per slab at a stonecutter), blast furnaces (3 smooth stone + 5 iron + 1 furnace) and armor stands (6 sticks + 1 smooth stone slab).
materials: Fuel: coal, charcoal, lava buckets or planks
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock: smelt stone once for smooth stone, and smooth stone slabs craft 6 from 3 (or 1:1 at the stonecutter in both editions).
versions: Smooth stone as a smelting product since 1.14 (Village & Pillage).

faq.q: How do you get smooth stone?
faq.a: Smelt stone in a furnace. Stone itself comes from smelting cobblestone, so every smooth stone block is two smelting passes from raw cobblestone.

faq.q: Can you craft smooth stone?
faq.a: No - it is smelting-only (or mined from villages). What you craft from it are smooth stone slabs, blast furnaces and armor stands.

faq.q: What is smooth stone used for?
faq.a: Mostly smooth stone slabs for building, plus blast furnaces and armor stands. Builders love it as a clean, texture-uniform slab material.

name: How to Make a Name Tag in Minecraft
quickAnswer: As of Drop 1 of 2026 name tags are craftable: 1 paper + 1 nugget of any type (iron or gold), shapeless. steps: Craft it (26.x): put 1 paper and any nugget (iron or gold both work) anywhere in the crafting grid - it is a shapeless recipe, new in Java 26.1 and Bedrock 26.0.

name: How to Get Honeycomb in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Shear a bee nest or beehive when it reaches honey level 5 - it drops 3 honeycombs. Place a lit campfire (or soul campfire) under the nest first or the bees will attack; a dispenser loaded with shears harvests without angering them at all. Honeycombs craft beehives, candles, honeycomb blocks and wax copper and signs.
steps: Find a bee nest: they generate on oak and birch trees in flower forests, plains and sunflower plains - or grow your own: oak/birch saplings planted within 2 blocks of a flower can grow with a nest.
Wait for honey level 5: the nest visibly drips honey and shows honey oozing from its holes when full. Bees fill it one level per pollen trip.
Place a lit campfire directly under the nest (or a soul campfire, or light a fire beneath) - the smoke pacifies the bees.
Shear the full nest: use shears on it to get 3 honeycombs. Without the campfire, every bee inside turns hostile.
Automate it: a dispenser facing the nest with shears inside harvests honeycomb without angering bees at all - hook it to an observer for a farm.
Use honeycombs: beehives (6 planks + 3 honeycomb), candles, honeycomb blocks (4 honeycomb), and waxing copper blocks to stop oxidation or waxing signs to lock their text.
materials: A lit campfire or soul campfire
Flowers and saplings to breed your own nests
editionNote: Harvesting works the same in Java and Bedrock: level 5, 3 honeycombs per shear, campfire pacification. Dispensers with shears work in both editions.
versions: Bee nest and honeycomb since 1.15 (Buzzy Bees); waxing copper since 1.17.

faq.q: Why do bees attack me when I collect honeycomb?
faq.a: You sheared without smoke. Put a lit campfire or soul campfire under the nest first, or use a dispenser with shears - both keep bees calm.

faq.q: How do I know when a bee nest is full?
faq.a: At honey level 5 the nest drips honey particles and honey visibly oozes from it. Only a full nest drops honeycomb when sheared.

faq.q: What can you do with honeycomb?
faq.a: Craft beehives, candles and honeycomb blocks, and wax copper blocks to freeze their oxidation stage or wax signs so their text cannot be edited.

name: How to Make a Campfire in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a campfire with 3 sticks, 1 coal or charcoal and 3 logs: stick on top center, stick-coal-stick across the middle, and 3 logs along the bottom. It cooks 4 food items at once with no fuel, pacifies bees, makes a smoke signal (24 blocks high with a hay bale under it) and gives light level 15 without spreading fire.
steps: Gather materials: 3 sticks, 1 coal or charcoal, and 3 logs of any type (stripped logs, wood, stems and hyphae all work).
Craft it: stick in top center, stick-coal-stick in the middle row, 3 logs filling the bottom row.
Cook on it: right-click with raw food - up to 4 items at once, no fuel needed, done in 30 seconds each. Food pops off when cooked.
Use it under bee nests: a lit campfire pacifies bees so you can shear honeycomb or bottle honey safely.
Make a smoke signal: smoke rises about 10 blocks normally, but place a hay bale underneath and it floats up 24 blocks - a cheap beacon for navigation.
Light and relight: campfires give off light level 15 and never spread fire, unlike normal fire. Extinguish with water or a shovel; relight with flint and steel, fire charges or flaming projectiles.
Watch your step: standing on a lit campfire deals 1 damage per half-second (Frost Walker boots make you immune). It also generates naturally in trail ruins and abandoned camps.
materials: 3 logs (any type, stripped or wood variants work)
Optional: hay bale for a taller smoke signal
editionNote: Identical crafting and behavior in Java and Bedrock. Soul campfires are the blue variant: same recipe with soul soil or soul sand instead of coal, light level 10.
versions: Campfire since 1.14 (Village & Pillage).

faq.q: How do you make a campfire?
faq.a: 3 sticks, 1 coal or charcoal and 3 logs in a crafting table: stick-coal-stick in the middle row with a stick on top center and logs along the bottom.

faq.q: How far does campfire smoke go?
faq.a: About 10 blocks normally and 24 blocks with a hay bale placed underneath - enough to mark your base from far away.

faq.q: Does a campfire spread fire?
faq.a: Never. Campfire flames do not spread under any circumstances, which makes them safe around wood builds - but they still damage mobs and players standing on top.

name: How to Breed Horses in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Tame two horses, then feed each a golden apple or golden carrot - they enter love mode and drop a foal. The foal's speed, jump and health average both parents' stats plus a random roll, so breeding two good horses slowly improves the bloodline. Foals take 20 minutes to grow (feed them to speed it up).
steps: Tame both parents: mount each horse repeatedly until hearts appear. Horses with higher temper take more attempts - feed apples, wheat or hay bales to speed taming.
Craft the breeding food: golden apple (apple + 8 gold ingots) or golden carrot (carrot + 8 gold nuggets) - one for each parent.
Feed both horses: they enter love mode, kiss, and a foal spawns with a random mix of the parents' coat and markings (35 combinations exist).
Understand the stats: foal speed, jump height and health are the average of both parents plus a random roll - two fast parents usually give a fast foal, but RNG can bite.
Grow the foal: it takes 20 minutes naturally; feed it apples, wheat, sugar, hay bales or golden carrots to cut the time (hay bales cut the most).
Select and repeat: keep the best foal, breed it back with the best adult - a few generations of selective breeding gets you near-max speed and 5-block jumps.
Bonus: breed a horse with a donkey to get a mule - chest-carrying and rideable, but sterile.
materials: 2 tamed horses (saddle not needed for breeding)
Fences or leads to keep the parents put
Optional: hay bales for faster foal growth
editionNote: Breeding works identically in Java and Bedrock: same foods, same stat inheritance, same 20-minute growth.
versions: Horse since 1.6.1 (Horse Update); breeding since the same update.

faq.q: What do horses eat to breed?
faq.a: Golden apples or golden carrots only - wheat and apples tame and heal, but they do not trigger love mode for breeding.

faq.q: How do I get a faster horse?
faq.a: Breed your two fastest horses: the foal averages both parents' speed plus a random roll. Repeat over generations and keep the winners - you can approach the 14.5 blocks/second cap.

faq.q: Can you breed a horse and a donkey?
faq.a: Yes - the result is a mule, which can carry a chest and be ridden, but cannot breed itself.

name: How to Make Concrete in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft concrete powder (4 sand + 4 gravel + 1 dye = 8 powder), then touch it to water - it instantly solidifies into concrete. Farm trick: build a tower of powder over a water stream and let it fall in, converting stacks in seconds. Concrete is the strongest solid color block for building.
steps: Craft concrete powder: 4 sand, 4 gravel and 1 dye of any of the 16 colors gives 8 powder blocks.
Convert it: powder touching water (source, flowing, or waterlogged blocks in Java) becomes solid concrete instantly.
Fast method - gravity: concrete powder falls like sand. Drop it from above through a water column and it solidifies mid-fall into concrete.
Mass-production setup: a water stream on the ground with a powder tower above - hold right-click with powder and watch stacks convert themselves.
Mine the concrete with a pickaxe (any tier) - it drops itself; without a pickaxe it drops nothing.
Use it: pure, vibrant color blocks for pixel art, modern builds and roads - the cleanest palette in the game.
materials: Sand and gravel (shovel a beach and a gravel mountain)
Dye of your chosen color (flowers, smelting, trades)
editionNote: In Java, waterlogged blocks also convert powder; in Bedrock it must touch actual water. Both editions convert instantly on contact.
versions: Concrete and concrete powder since 1.12 (World of Color Update).

faq.q: How do you turn concrete powder into concrete?
faq.a: Touch it to water - any contact with a source block, flowing water or (Java) waterlogged blocks solidifies it instantly. Rain does not count.

faq.q: What is the fastest way to make concrete?
faq.a: Use gravity: hold powder and let it fall through a water stream. The falling entity converts on contact, so you can convert whole stacks in seconds without placing each block.

faq.q: Can you un-harden concrete?
faq.a: No - concrete never turns back into powder. Place it carefully or keep it as powder until you are sure of the spot.

name: How to Tame a Cat in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Find a stray cat in a village (or the black cat at a swamp hut), hold raw cod or raw salmon, stand still and let it come to you, then feed it until hearts appear. Tamed cats scare away creepers and phantoms, sleep on your bed, and bring you morning gifts.
steps: Find stray cats in villages: they spawn around villages with at least 5 claimed beds within 48 blocks - more beds means more cats.
Stock up on raw cod or raw salmon: fish a river or ocean first - taming can take several fish.
Approach slowly: cats flee from players who move fast. Hold the fish, crouch, and stand still - the cat approaches within 10 blocks on its own.
Feed it when close: right-click with the fish until hearts appear and the collar shows - the cat is yours.
Use its superpowers: creepers and phantoms stay away from cats - park one at your base entrance and sleep phantom-free.
Enjoy the gifts: a cat sleeping on your bed may bring morning presents - string, rabbit's foot, feathers, even phantom membranes.
Black cats: 50% of cats spawned during a full moon are black, and the swamp hut's cat is always black - rare variants for collectors.
materials: Raw cod or raw salmon (several - RNG is RNG)
A fishing rod to stock up first
A village with 5+ claimed beds (or a swamp hut)
editionNote: Taming is the same in both editions, but Bedrock cats go from 10 health wild to 20 health tamed, and Bedrock villages actively spawn cats to fill a quota of 1 per 4 beds (max 5).
versions: Cat as its own mob since 1.14 (before that, ocelots turned into cats).

faq.q: How do you tame a cat in Minecraft?
faq.a: Hold raw cod or salmon near a stray cat, stand still (crouching helps), let it approach, then feed it until hearts appear. Moving fast makes it flee.

faq.q: What are cats good for?
faq.a: Creepers and phantoms avoid them - a cat near your base or bed is a real defense. Tamed cats also bring gift items when they sleep with you.

faq.a: Half of all cats spawned during a full moon are black, and the cat that spawns with a swamp hut is always black - the rarest look in the game.

name: How to Make a Copper Golem in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Place a block of copper (any oxidation stage, waxed works too) and put a carved pumpkin or jack o'lantern on top - the pumpkin must be placed last. The copper block turns into a copper chest and the golem spawns on it, ready to sort your items.
steps: Gather the materials: 1 block of copper (9 copper ingots) and 1 carved pumpkin - shear a regular pumpkin - or a jack o'lantern.
Place the block of copper where you want the golem. Any oxidation stage works, waxed blocks too, and the pattern works horizontally or even upside-down.
Place the carved pumpkin or jack o'lantern last - by hand, with a dispenser, or even let an enderman do it.
The copper block transforms into a copper chest facing the pumpkin's direction and the copper golem spawns where the pumpkin was, matching the block's oxidation stage.

Put it to work: the golem takes up to 16 of the first item it finds in copper chests and files them into nearby wooden chests or trapped chests that are empty or already contain that item type - a fully automatic sorting system.

Maintain it: use a honeycomb to wax it and freeze oxidation, or scrape with an axe to revert one stage. Unwaxed golems fully oxidize in 21-23 in-game days and freeze into a copper golem statue - use an axe on the statue to bring it back.
materials: 1 carved pumpkin (pumpkin + shears) or jack o'lantern
Optional: honeycomb to wax the golem
Optional: copper chests and wooden chests for the sorting setup
editionNote: The build is identical in Java (1.21.9) and Bedrock (1.21.111). When sorting, Java golems cannot tell apart potion contents, tipped arrow types or suspicious stews - Bedrock golems can. Both ignore durability, enchantments and custom names.
versions: Added in Java 1.21.9 and Bedrock 1.21.111. The copper golem lost the 2021 mob vote and finally arrived four years later with a chest-sorting job instead of pressing buttons.

faq.q: Does the copper golem spawn naturally?
faq.a: No. It only exists when a player builds it (copper block + pumpkin placed last), from a spawn egg, or when you reanimate an unwaxed copper golem statue with an axe.

faq.q: What happens when a copper golem fully oxidizes?
faq.a: It freezes into a copper golem statue and drops whatever it was holding. Scrape an unwaxed statue with an axe to bring the golem back - waxing with honeycomb at any stage prevents this entirely.

faq.q: How does copper golem sorting work?
faq.a: It opens copper chests, takes up to 16 of the first item type it finds, and places them in nearby wooden or trapped chests that are empty or already contain that item. It remembers up to 9 copper chests and resets after checking 10 empty ones.

keywords: copper golem how to make build block of copper carved pumpkin sort chests oxidation statue minecraft

name: How to Tame and Ride a Nautilus in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Find a nautilus in any ocean biome between Y 38 and 58 and feed it pufferfish or buckets of pufferfish - each one has a 1/3 chance to tame it. Put a saddle on it to ride: it hits 6.5 m/s underwater and has a chargeable dash.
steps: Find a nautilus: they swim in every ocean biome (any temperature) between Y-levels 38 and 58, in groups of 1-3. In Bedrock 10% spawn as babies, which are already passive.
Tame it: feed pufferfish or buckets of pufferfish. Each one has a 1 in 3 chance of taming, and holding one also tempts the nautilus to follow you.
Interact once and it becomes persistent - it stops counting toward the water creature cap and never despawns.
Saddle it: use a saddle on the tamed nautilus (craftable since 1.21.6 with 3 leather and 1 iron ingot). Remove it later with shears.

Ride it: standard movement controls. The nautilus gains speed in a straight line up to 6.5 m/s, and pressing jump triggers a dash - hold jump to charge a longer one. Your XP bar becomes the dash meter while riding.
Armor it with nautilus armor (copper through diamond as chest loot, netherite via smithing), and heal or breed adults by feeding any fish or bucket of fish - pufferfish heals 2 HP, raw cod heals 4.
Alternative: the zombie nautilus is tamed the same way, is faster (7.15 m/s) and never despawns even on Peaceful - but it is undead, so Instant Health potions hurt it and you cannot breed it.
materials: Pufferfish or buckets of pufferfish (several, 1/3 tame chance each)
Optional: nautilus armor (loot from shipwrecks, ocean ruins or buried treasure)
Optional: any fish for healing and breeding
editionNote: Added in Java 1.21.11 and Bedrock 1.21.130. In Bedrock you cannot go through Nether or End portals while riding a nautilus, and babies spawn naturally 10% of the time.
versions: Nautilus: Java 1.21.11 / Bedrock 1.21.130. Saddles craftable since Java 1.21.6 / Bedrock 1.21.90.

faq.q: Can a tamed nautilus despawn?
faq.a: No. The first time any player interacts with a nautilus it becomes persistent and stops counting toward any mob cap. Zombie nautiluses do not despawn even on Peaceful difficulty.

faq.q: How fast is a nautilus?
faq.a: Up to 6.5 m/s swimming in a straight line (7.15 m/s for the zombie nautilus), plus a chargeable dash on the jump control. On land it crawls at 0.88 m/s, so keep it in the water.

faq.q: Can you breed nautiluses?
faq.a: Living nautiluses, yes: feed two tamed adults any fish. Zombie nautiluses cannot be bred - there is no baby variant.

keywords: nautilus minecraft tame ride saddle pufferfish dash underwater mount zombie nautilus armor

name: How to Find Buried Treasure in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Loot a buried treasure map from a shipwreck's map chest (every wreck with 2+ chests has one) or an ocean ruins chest, travel to the red X and dig: the chest sits at chunk-relative coordinates 9,9 in Java (8,8 in Bedrock), a few blocks down. Every chest contains a heart of the sea.
steps: Find a shipwreck - floating on the surface or sunken on the ocean floor - and loot the map chest in the lower stern: it always contains one buried treasure map. Ocean ruins chests can hold maps too.
Open the map: the red X marks the treasure. Your player arrow grows as you get close.
Stand on the X, then align precisely: in Java press F3 and move until the chunk-relative coordinates read 9, 9; in Bedrock they read 8, 8. In Java the chest always faces east.
Dig down through sand or gravel (sometimes stone if it generated on an underwater hillside) - the chest is usually only a few blocks deep and may be underwater and waterlogged.
Loot it: every buried treasure contains a heart of the sea - the only way to get one - plus iron, gold, diamonds, emeralds, TNT and cooked fish.
Craft a conduit with the heart of the sea and 8 nautilus shells for underwater breathing and vision.
Keep hunting: each map leads to one treasure, but different shipwrecks hand out maps to different treasures. In Bedrock, buried treasures generate far more often than in Java.
materials: A buried treasure map (shipwreck map chest or ocean ruins chest)
Shovel (digging sand and gravel is faster)
Optional: door or water breathing for underwater digs
editionNote: Treasures generate in beach and snowy beach biomes in both editions; Bedrock also gets them in stony shore and mushroom field shore, and generates them far more often. Dig spot: chunk-relative 9,9 in Java (chest always faces east), 8,8 in Bedrock.
versions: Since Java 1.13 / Bedrock 1.4.0 (Update Aquatic).

faq.q: Is buried treasure the only source of the heart of the sea?
faq.a: Yes. Every buried treasure chest contains exactly one heart of the sea, and it cannot be obtained anywhere else - you need it to craft a conduit.

faq.q: I am standing on the X but cannot find the chest. What now?
faq.a: Center yourself on the X and check the chunk coordinates: 9,9 in Java (F3), 8,8 in Bedrock. Dig a 3x3 hole down around that spot - the chest can be buried under sand, gravel or stone, sometimes below the waterline.

faq.q: Do treasure maps ever point to the same chest?
faq.a: Maps found as loot never repeat a structure you already have a map for, so each new map from a shipwreck or ruin leads to fresh treasure.

keywords: buried treasure minecraft map shipwreck heart of the sea dig x marks chunk coordinates conduit

name: How to Make Fireworks in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 3 firework rockets with 1 paper and 1-3 gunpowder - more gunpowder means longer flight. Leave out the firework star for elytra boosting (star-equipped rockets explode and hurt you); add one for shows or crossbow ammo.
steps: Gather paper (3 sugar cane in a row makes 3 paper) and gunpowder (creepers, ghasts, witches).
Craft rockets: 1 paper + 1, 2 or 3 gunpowder gives 3 firework rockets. Each extra gunpowder raises the flight duration (shown on the tooltip), up to duration 3.
For elytra boosting keep them star-free: a rocket with no firework star has no explosion, so it never damages you when it ends.
Boost while gliding: use a rocket mid-flight to propel yourself at 33.5 blocks per second; the boost length scales with flight duration. You can also take off from the ground this way.
For a show or a weapon, make a firework star first: gunpowder + any dye (add extras like glowstone dust for twinkle or a diamond for trail), then craft paper + gunpowder + the star.
Use them as ammo: load a rocket into a crossbow - it only deals damage if it has a firework star, and each extra star adds damage. Dispensers launch rockets in the direction they face.
materials: 1 paper per craft (3 sugar cane = 3 paper)
editionNote: Identical crafting and boosting in Java and Bedrock. In Java, a rocket shot from a crossbow explodes instantly when it hits an entity.
versions: Rockets since Java 1.4.6 / Bedrock 1.2.0; elytra boosting since Java 1.11.1 / Bedrock 1.10.0.

faq.q: Do fireworks damage you when boosting elytra?
faq.a: Only if the rocket contains a firework star. Star-free rockets have no explosion and are always safe - that is why elytra pilots craft plain paper + gunpowder rockets.

faq.q: How high do fireworks fly?
faq.a: Between 8-20 blocks with 1 gunpowder, 18-34 with 2 and 32-52 with 3, plus small random variation. The tooltip shows the flight duration as 1, 2 or 3.

faq.q: How do I make colored explosions?
faq.a: Craft a firework star first: gunpowder plus one or more dyes sets the colors. Add a diamond for a trail, glowstone dust for twinkle, or a head/gold nugget/feather/fire charge to change the explosion shape, then combine the star with paper and gunpowder.

keywords: firework rocket minecraft craft paper gunpowder elytra boost flight duration firework star crossbow

name: How to Get Silk Touch in Minecraft

faq.q: Can Silk Touch and Fortune go on the same pickaxe?

name: How to Make a Book in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a book with 3 paper and 1 leather. Paper comes from sugar cane (3 cane = 3 paper) and leather from cows or horses - farm sugar cane early, because books become bookshelves, and 15 bookshelves unlock max-level enchanting.
